remarks: Studio suite located on level 5 of the premier Tamarack Club. Fractional ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month, on a rotating basis. Ownership amenities include private owner locker room, private owner's lounge, year 'round access to the indoor/outdoor heated pool, 2 hot tubs, fitness center sauna, underground parking while lodging overnight, valet parking during ski season, discounts on golf and daily lift tickets. Wonderful views of the golf course/slopes from the balcony. Renovations are scheduled for this level starting in the fall of 2026!
